column1: # Upstream skills — THE curated set, one manifest for both hosts (parity by construction).
#   Claude Code: install.sh keeps a shallow git checkout of each repo (pulled on session start by
#                ai-update → live), and ai-init links each listed skill into the app repo's
#                .claude/skills/ (git-excluded) → only these skills exist, so nothing duplicates.
#   Hermes:      hermes.sh installs each row through the skills hub (`hermes skills update` = live).
# Only named skills, never a whole pack: every row owns one job in the AI brain (skills/ai-kit/SKILL.md).
# Deliberately NOT installed (they compete with a kit owner):
#   anthropics/skills claude-api, openai/skills openai-docs, google-gemini gemini-api-dev
#     → each steers code to ONE vendor SDK; AI Kit has one integration layer (AI SDK + llm-router),
#       every vendor is a provider row in providers.json, never a second code path.
#   OpenRouterTeam openrouter-oauth (end-user PKCE keys — the site owns the key), openrouter-stt/tts
#   huggingface hf-cli / huggingface-papers (generic; ml-lab only needs the four below)
#   Marketing Kit already owns email/SMS SENDING (resend, react-email, telnyx-messaging) and
#     site-wide tracking (journey-analytics) → AI Kit hands off, never reinstalls.
# hosts: both | claude | hermes      trust: community (Hermes scanner decides) | official (vendor org, --force)
